fields.summary: QA- End to End Validation for TypeScript tool "LIZARD"
fields.description:
## Summary

Perform end-to-end validation of the **LIZARD** tool on a **TypeScript** repository using the Testable QA environment. Verify successful execution, metric/report accuracy, and correct platform ingestion.

### Objective

Validate that **LIZARD** integrates correctly with the Testable White Box analysis pipeline and produces the expected outputs mapped in **Testable_Strategy_Metrics_Mapping_v0.2** (White Box sheet).

Primary TypeScript tool in Strategy v0.2 (White Box sheet, TypeScript column).

### Strategy Mapping Reference

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source file | Testable_Strategy_Metrics_Mapping_v0.2 (White Box sheet) |
| Tool | LIZARD |
| Metrics covered by this tool | **6** |
| Language focus | TypeScript |

### Metrics Covered (from Strategy v0.2)

| L3 Technique | L4 Classification | L5 Metric | TS Primary | TS Secondary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cyclomatic Complexity | Static Analysis Metric | Execution Path Integrity | Lizard | Plato |
| Cyclomatic Complexity | Decision Coverage | Decision Outcome Verification | Lizard | Plato |
| Cyclomatic Complexity | Condition Coverage | Logical Sub-expression Validation | Lizard | Plato |
| Cyclomatic Complexity | Logic Coverage Metric | Total Logical Combinatorial Coverage | Lizard | Plato |
| Cyclomatic Complexity | Maintainability Analysis | Technical Debt Impact | Lizard | Plato |
| Cyclomatic Complexity | Test Prioritization | QA Resource Allocation | Lizard | Plato |

### Validation Scope

* Verify the tool executes successfully on a representative TypeScript repository.
* Confirm raw tool output is generated without errors.
* Validate mapped metrics above are present directly or via documented derivation.
* Compare platform-ingested values with local tool execution.
* Ensure reports are stored/displayed correctly in Testable.

### Expected Result

* **LIZARD** completes execution successfully.
* All **6** mapped metrics are supported or correctly derived.
* Results display correctly in Testable without tool failure messages.

### Deliverables

* End-to-end validation results
* Execution logs
* Generated LIZARD report/output
* Screenshots of successful execution (if applicable)
